retrieval_query: Account & Security 2FA Reset request security lockout two factor authentication session freeze
draft_response:
Hello Elena,

We have detected the unauthorized access alerts you reported. As an immediate safeguard, we have terminated all active sessions and placed a temporary security freeze on credential changes.

In strict compliance with our Account Security Policy (POL-SEC-002), automated 2FA resets are prohibited to prevent account hijacking. A security specialist has been assigned to verify your identity and guide you through secure credential recovery.

Sincerely,
NovaTech Information Security Team
